name: Sole e isole volanti
motif: A sweeping aerial view from the underside of a floating island bridge: distant golden sun and numerous floating islands, a sky gardener's forgotten watering can tied to the railing. LUMINOUS CLOUDS BLUE THEN INDIGO THEN VIOLET THEN PASTEL PINK; no orange cloud layer. Anime fantasy wonder, distinct composition.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Original wide 16:9 full-bleed painterly anime fantasy Oculum background. PRIMARY SCENE: An impossible floating-island sky route between broken arches and hanging gardens, viewed diagonally along a rough rope bridge. Luminous blue, indigo, violet and pastel pink clouds dominate, small gold solar occupation banners contrast with abandoned poor travellers' shelters. NO visible sun disc in this scene, no coins. Keep the whole page naturally illustrated with a broad quiet darker central region for readable controls, never a blank rectangular panel. Matte hand-painted gouache, controlled anime fantasy shape design, believable organic detail and materials, no shiny 3D. First reference is ONLY brush technique: never copy its geography, composition, sunset, objects or sky. No solar disc or sky-eye. No Moon body in the sky. No coins, currency discs or round eye medallions. Clouds, only where naturally present, mix luminous BLUE dominant then INDIGO then VIOLET then PASTEL PINK. Vary architecture, scale, silhouette, viewpoint and lighting from the other themes. Tell the story through details alone. NO text, UI, writing, logos, signatures or watermarks.
